task: Find a popular recipe for a chocolate chip cookie and list the ingredients and preparation steps.
answer: Found the popular recipe "Best Chocolate Chip Cookies" on Allrecipes (4.6 stars, 19,337 ratings, 14,916 reviews) via site search for "chocolate chip cookies". Ingredients: 1 cup butter (softened); 3/4 cup white sugar; 3/4 cup packed brown sugar; 2 large eggs; 2 teaspoons vanilla extract; 1 teaspoon baking soda; 2 teaspoons hot water; 1/2 teaspoon salt; 3 cups all-purpose flour; 2 cups semisweet chocolate chips; 1 cup chopped walnuts. Preparation steps: 1) Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C); 2) Cream butter and sugars until fluffy; 3) Beat in eggs and vanilla; 4) Dissolve baking soda in hot water and add to batter with salt; 5) Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and walnuts; 6) Drop rounded spoonfuls onto ungreased baking sheets; 7) Bake 10 minutes until edges brown; 8) Cool on sheets briefly; 9) Transfer to wire racks to cool completely.
